method.description: Per-record independent review per plan.md Phase 2: each record's class was independently re-derived from judgmentTimeInput alone under the frozen decision table by broker-backed analysis workers operating from a separate broker, then compared with the recorded label. Source-only, no-live; workers never saw this repository's runtime and returned structured verdicts.
method.evidence: Every review execution is a broker task record with signed result provenance (EdDSA over rfc8785-jcs canonicalization) retained off-repo; opaque reviewer aliases only. Attempt counts per slice are recorded so aggregate attestations are never mistaken for itemized per-record lists.
method.collectorNote: The labeling party collected and validated coverage but did not participate in any verdict; disputed or deferred records would have been carried as such.

reviews.note: Three executions across two workers (same broker), all attesting full per-record re-derivation with 32/32 agreement; the itemized per-record list was not emitted by the bridge output envelope, so the attestation is recorded at aggregate grade.
Three executions across two workers (same broker), all attesting full per-record re-derivation with 28/28 agreement; itemized list not emitted, recorded at aggregate grade.

labelLedger.rule: No label changes after holdout scoring begins (plan.md Phase 2); any revision restarts Phase 3 with a new holdout window.

carriedFindings: requesterClass=unknown is absorbed by the rule-3 fallback without an explicit clause; a future policy revision should state its handling and the migration rule.
Records with a probe-like signature but payloadFilePresent=true fall to the fallback; the payload-presence condition in rule 1 should be revisited if real probe traffic is captured.
messageWordsBand is inert under the fallback, so band-derivation defects would be structurally undetected in this corpus; sample cross-checks against original captures are recommended before Phase 3.

The window contains no rule-1 (probe) or rule-2 (proceed) firings, so arm comparison on this corpus evaluates the fallback path almost exclusively; interpret Phase 3 class-agreement metrics accordingly.
alternativeAcceptable depends entirely on bundleFilesBand in this window; band derivation errors would flip the flag in bulk.

Full agreement between recorded labels and re-derivation cannot by itself rule out that labels were produced by the same table; the circularity note is recorded and Phase 3 arms provide the substantive test.
